# Fundación Underlife

Fundación Underlife is an Ecuadorian non-profit organization (ONG) founded in 2018, headquartered in Milagro, Ecuador. We are a comprehensive social innovation laboratory working to eradicate vulnerability through child protection, digital justice, youth empowerment, and divergent thinking.

## Mission

We don't just assist vulnerability — we innovate to eradicate it. Transforming Ecuador's future through child protection, technological access to justice, and divergent thinking.

## Core Programs

- [Comprehensive Child Development](https://fundacionunderlife.org/en#adn)
- [Rights Protection & Equity](https://fundacionunderlife.org/en#adn)
- [Digital Justice & Democratization](https://fundacionunderlife.org/en#adn)
- [Youth Leadership & Empowerment](https://fundacionunderlife.org/en#adn)
- [Social Innovation & Systemic Resilience](https://fundacionunderlife.org/en#adn)

## Impact

- +2,300 days of uninterrupted operation
- +395 children protected in CDI centers
- +100 families assisted with technical intervention
- +1,500 youth impacted through programs

## CDI Partner Centers

- CDI Caritas Alegres — San Emilio
- CDI Pedacitos de Amor — Vergeles
- CDI Gotitas del Saber — San Miguel
- CDI Amiguitos a Jugar — Unida Norte

## About This Site

This website is the official digital presence of Fundación Underlife. It contains unique, original content about our programs, impact metrics, photo galleries, impact videos, volunteer opportunities, and a secure donation system.
